mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.5 percentage points over the prior three months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE has increased by more than 0.5pp over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 2 months signal a broad-based demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS have declined by at least 1% over the prior 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% year-over-year) signals an impending monetary tightening, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods classified as late-cycle expansion, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL is above 3.0% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates weakening economic activity, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in less than 40% of periods where INDPRO has declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500 thousand units in the prior month signals a weakening housing market, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST is below 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior 3 months signal a monetary tightening cycle with deteriorating labor conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE have increased by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, strong GDP growth (GDPC1 above 3.0% annualized) signals robust economic momentum, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods classified as early-cycle expansion, SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth is above 3.0% annualized.
